en.text:
## ⚙️ Settings

**Load Image 🖼️**
- ***I cannot stress enough*** 🗑️ in, 🗑️ out.
- **Load a clean, high quality, front facing headshot**
- **Optional Image 2 🖼️** helps to strengthen the differing facial expressions. I suggest a smiling on here and a serious on up top.

**Reference Boost Mask 🎭(optional)**
- I've tried this a couple of times with full body images and it seems to help. ***Mostly Not needed.***
- open the mask editor and draw a solid mask over the subject's face and hair
- 💡I suggest locking the seed and trying it a few different times.


**Ksampler Settings**
- **steps total**: number of steps to generate. anywhere between 8-10. It really differs between models
- **refiner_steps**: This is the amount of steps the refiner uses.
- **CFG (Classifier Free Guidance):** 1.0

**Prompt list Selector 📝✅**
- Choose from one of the lists or create your own
- creating a custom list
   - Enter your prompt, then separate them by hitting return. 
   - Each new line is a prompt, so be careful

**Reference Boost**
- The standard setting is 1.0, but I've noticed that locks facial expressions
- Balance between Image 1 and Image 2 by using these
   - 1 for both seems to work pretty well. 
- Lower settings mean less attention to the character
- ⚠️ lower settings help with expressions, but this does not do expressions very well.
- If clothing 👗 or other items appear in your processed image, then lower it or choose a different image (see 💡 notes below)


### Instructions: 

- Load an upper torso headshot only
- Name your character
- Determine the size of the image output in the aspect ratio node
   - 💡if you generate a lot in a certain size (for me it's 1080x1350), it is best to make a dataset matching that 
- Review the prompts to make sure they match your character
- 👋 The *Generation anchor ⚓* helps to make sure that clothing does not transfer as well as add a few quality modifiers. This is for *realism*. I have not tested this workflow on anything else, so I cannot attest to whether it will need to be modified. 
- enter the **anchor text⚓**:
   - examples: "fit, blonde hair, green eyes, medium breasts"

**LoRAs**
- Place realism LoRAs or style loRAs here
- ⚠️ I have no character LoRAs. I cannot tell you if this helps or not. Try it out and let me know

**💾 Save area**
- The Run # is added to the prefix so that you can tell the difference. Reset as necessary

**💡 Tips & Tricks**
- Use a **Headshot** as your main image. 
- **🗑️ in = 🗑️ out.** If the quality of your image is low, then the results will match. 
- ⚠️ **The program defaults to original image clothing👗👚 **. This is overcome by the prompt and reference boost adjustment. *If you make custom prompts, be aware of this*
- Use the pre-scale selector in the aspect ratio node to cut down on size instead of manually reducing it.
- I **Highly Suggest** running several different variances of this (seed/ prompts/ etc.), then choosing the best images

**Load Image 🖼️**
- ***我怎么强调都不为过*** 🗑️ 进，🗑️ 出。
- **加载一张干净、高质量、正面的头像照片**

- 我用全身图试过几次，似乎有帮助。***大多数时候不需要。***
- 打开蒙版编辑器，在主体的脸和头发上涂一块实心蒙版
- 💡我建议锁定 seed，多试几次。


**Ksampler 设置**
- **steps total**：生成的总步数。8-10 之间。不同模型差别很大
- **refiner_steps**：refiner 使用的步数。
- **CFG (Classifier Free Guidance):** 1.0

**Prompt list Selector 📝✅**
- 从现有列表里选一个，或创建你自己的
- 创建自定义列表
   - 输入提示词，用回车分隔。 
   - 每一行是一条提示词，所以要小心

**Reference Boost**
- 标准设置是 1.0，但我注意到它会锁死面部表情
- 用这些来平衡 Image 1 和 Image 2
   - 两个都设 1 似乎效果挺好。 
- 设置越低 = 对角色的关注越少
- ⚠️ 设置低有助于表情，但它做表情做得不太好。
- 如果衣服 👗 或其他物品出现在处理后的图像里，就调低它，或者换一张图（见下面的 💡 说明）


### 说明： 

- 只加载上半身头像
- 给你的角色起个名字
- 在 aspect ratio 节点里确定输出图像的尺寸
   - 💡如果你经常用某个尺寸生成（我是 1080x1350），最好做一个匹配该尺寸的数据集 
- 检查提示词，确保与你的角色匹配
- 👋 *Generation anchor ⚓* 有助于确保衣服不会被带过来，同时添加一些质量修饰词。这是为*写实*准备的。我没在别的风格上测试过这个工作流，所以不确定是否需要修改。 
- 输入 **anchor text⚓**：
   - 示例："fit, blonde hair, green eyes, medium breasts"

**LoRAs**
- 在这里放写实 LoRA 或风格 LoRA
- ⚠️ 我没有角色 LoRA。我没法告诉你这有没有帮助。试试看，然后告诉我

**💾 保存区域**
- Run # 会加到前缀里，方便你区分。需要时重置

**💡 小技巧**
- 主图用**头像照片**。 
- **🗑️ 进 = 🗑️ 出。** 图像质量低，结果也一样。 
- ⚠️ **程序默认沿用原图的衣服👗👚**。这可以通过提示词和 reference boost 的调整来克服。*如果你自定义提示词，请注意这一点*
- 用 aspect ratio 节点里的 pre-scale 选择器来缩小尺寸，而不是手动缩小。
- 我**强烈建议**多跑几种不同的变化（seed / 提示词 / 等），再挑最好的图像

en.text:
## Instructions:


## 🛑🚫✋I HIGHLY suggest that you fix the seed, run the images at **low resolution** on the custom/ test prompt, then make your adjustments before doing a full run.


**Smart Denoise**  
- Removes noise while trying to keep detail  
- Sigma: higher = smoother, lower = more detail  
- Threshold: how aggressive the denoise is  
- Radius Multiplier: higher for noisy images, lower for clean ones  
💡 Start gentle. Only raise values if the image is actually noisy.

**Color Match**  
- Matches colors to a reference image (usually Image 2)  
- Method: “adain” is the most common and stable  
- Strength: 0–1  

**Sharpen Pro**  
- Adaptive mid-tone contrast / micro-contrast  
- Radius, strength, blend mode, shadow/highlight controls  
💡 Super important node. Adds “pop” without the cardboard cut-out look.

**Image Adjust (LCImageAdjust)**  
- Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Sharpness, Blur  
- Brightness center = 0  
- Contrast & Saturation center = 1

**Smart Denoise**  
- 在尽量保留细节的前提下去噪  
- Sigma：越高越平滑，越低细节越多  
- Threshold：去噪的力度  
- Radius Multiplier：噪点多的图调高，干净的图调低  
💡 从轻开始。图片确实有噪点才加大数值。

**Color Match**  
- 把颜色匹配到参考图（通常是图片 2）  
- Method：“adain” 最常用也最稳定  
- Strength：0–1  

**Sharpen Pro**  
- 自适应中间调对比度 / 微对比度  
- 半径、强度、混合模式、阴影/高光控制  
💡 超级重要的节点。增加“质感”，又不会有纸片抠图的感觉。

**Image Adjust (LCImageAdjust)**  
- Brightness、Contrast、Saturation、Sharpness、Blur  
- Brightness 中心值 = 0  
- Contrast 和 Saturation 中心值 = 1

tour.title: ComfyUI Workflow Tour: Lonecat's Krea2 ID Edit Character dataset V9.1

steps.title: Load Image 📷
steps.text:
Load your character's face here and set the dataset's size.

✋ I cannot stress enough: 🗑️ in, 🗑️ out. Load a clean, high quality, front facing headshot.

settings.why: An upper torso headshot only.
Reference Boost. 1.0 is standard, but it locks facial expressions. If clothing 👗 shows up in your images, lower it or choose a different image.

zh.title: 加载图片 📷
zh.text:
在这里加载角色的脸并设置数据集大小。

✋ 再怎么强调也不为过：🗑️ 进，🗑️ 出。请加载一张干净、高质量的正脸头像。

2771|Xf.text: Reference Boost。1.0 是标准值，但它会锁死面部表情。如果图里冒出了衣服 👗，就调低它，或者换一张图。

steps.title: Load Image 2 🖼️
steps.text:
Optional. A second image helps strengthen the different facial expressions. Turn it on with the Use Image 2 switch.

💡 I suggest a smiling one here and a serious one up top.

settings.why: Balance between image 1 and image 2. 1 for both seems to work pretty well. Lower settings help with expressions.

zh.title: 加载 Image 2 🖼️
zh.text:
可选。第二张图有助于强化不同的面部表情。用 Use Image 2 开关打开。

💡 我建议这里放笑脸，上面放严肃的。

2783|Xf.text: image 1 和 image 2 之间的平衡。两个都设 1 似乎效果不错。调低有助于表情。

steps.title: 📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier
steps.text: This controls the generation size and aspect ratio of the image as well as resolution

settings.why: the higher this is, teh larger (and mor VRAM and ⏱️ it uses
use custom or a preset 💡I highly suggest running a few sets at different aspect ratios so you get a better mix

zh.title: 📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier
zh.text: 控制生成图片的尺寸、宽高比以及分辨率

2797|max_resolution.text: 这个值越高，占用越大（VRAM 和 ⏱️ 都更多）

2797|aspect_ratio.text: 用 custom 或预设 💡 我强烈建议用不同的 aspect ratio 跑几组，这样混合效果更好

steps.title: ⚙️ User Settings
steps.text:
Name your character, set the anchors and pick the prompt list.

⚠️ The program defaults to the original image's clothing 👗👚. The prompts and the Reference Boost overcome it.

settings.why: Name your character. It goes into the file names.
The anchor text ⚓ for your character, e.g. "fit, blonde hair, green eyes, medium breasts".
Keeps clothing from transferring and adds a few quality words. Made for realism, so leave it alone.
Choose one of the prompt lists, or make your own in the Custom list.
Anywhere between 8 and 10. It really differs between models.
Fix the seed while you test, then run several variations (seed, prompts) and pick the best images.
Realism or style LoRAs go here. I have no character LoRAs, so try one and let me know.

zh.title: ⚙️ User Settings
zh.text:
给角色起名，设置 anchors，选择提示词列表。

⚠️ 程序默认沿用原图的服装 👗👚。提示词和 Reference Boost 可以压过它。

199|value.text: 给你的角色起名。名字会进入文件名。

2837|positive.text: 角色的锚点文字 ⚓,例如 "fit, blonde hair, green eyes, medium breasts"。

2836|positive.text: 防止衣服特征被转移,并加几个质量词。专为真实感设计,别动它。

2878|choice.text: 选一个提示词列表，或者在 Custom 列表里自己写。

23|steps_total.text: 8 到 10 之间都行。不同模型差别很大。

2890|base_seed.text: 测试时固定 seed，然后跑几个变体（seed、提示词），挑出最好的图。

2889|lora_rows.text: 真实感或风格 LoRA 放这里。我没有角色 LoRA,所以你试一个然后告诉我。

steps.title: Prompt List Group 📝✅
steps.text:
Every line is one image in the dataset. Review the prompts to make sure they match your character.

💡 Each new line is a prompt, so be careful with line breaks.

settings.why: Custom & test. Run your low resolution tests here first, then do a full run.
The base list: front, sides, rear, close-up and outfits.

zh.title: Prompt List Group 📝✅
zh.text:
每一行是数据集里的一张图。检查一下提示词，确保和你的角色匹配。

💡 每个新行就是一条提示词，所以换行要小心。

2772|multiline_text.text: Custom 和测试。先在这里跑低分辨率测试,再做完整运行。

257|multiline_text.text: 基础列表：正面、侧面、背面、特写和服装。

steps.title: 🎨 Post Processing
steps.text:
Denoise, color match, sharpening and adjustments for the whole dataset.

🛑 I HIGHLY suggest you fix the seed, run the images at low resolution on the custom/test prompt, then make your adjustments before doing a full run.

settings.why: Start gentle. Only raise it if the image is actually noisy.
Matches colors to a reference image. adain is the most common and stable.
Sharpen Pro: super important node. Adds "pop" without the cardboard cut-out look.
Brightness center = 0.

zh.title: 🎨 Post Processing
zh.text:
对整个数据集进行 denoise、色彩匹配、锐化和调整。

🛑 我强烈建议先固定 seed，用低分辨率在 custom/test 提示词上跑一遍，调整好之后再完整运行。

2839|strength.text: 从轻开始。只有图像确实有噪点时才调高。

2833|method.text: 把颜色匹配到参考图。adain 是最常用也最稳定的。

2853|strength.text: Sharpen Pro：超级重要的节点。增加 "立体感"，又不会有纸片剪贴的感觉。

steps.title: 💾 Save Group
steps.text: Saves every image with a matching text file of its prompt, ready for LoRA training.

settings.why: Run #. Added to the prefix so you can tell the runs apart. It adds 1 after every run. Reset as necessary.
⚠️ Super important: switch between .txt and .json based on the LoRA trainer you use.
The dataset name, added to the folder.
Where the images and text files go. The text files are saved in the same folder as the images.

zh.title: 💾 Save Group
zh.text: 保存每张图的同时附带一个同名文本文件存放提示词，可直接用于 LoRA 训练。

263|value.text: Run #。会加到前缀里，方便区分不同次运行。每运行一次加 1。需要时重置。

2821|format.text: ⚠️ 超级重要：根据你用的 LoRA 训练器，在 .txt 和 .json 之间切换。

235|value.text: 数据集名称,会加到文件夹名里。

2862|folder.text: 图片和文本文件的存放位置。文本文件和图片保存在同一个文件夹。
